items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I met him in St. Louis.

ctx.x: There was a man there called Charlie Creath and Charlie Creath is the brother to the wife of Zutty Singleton -- Marge. And his claim to fame, Charlie Creath. And I don't know too much about them, I think some of these days I'd like to get in touch with Marge -- Zutty passed away, and I know Marge was telling me all about her brother, Charlie Creath. I met him in St. Louis. I didn't hear the band he had but he had a band and a great band at that, you know. There was another band called George Hudson
Okay, George Hudson, who did he have in his band?
